title: Saga-DEX
tagline: Our mission is building a  DEX on its own dedicated Saga chainlet.
description: The importance of a dApp launching on its own dedicated chain, often called an app-chain, lies in its ability to achieve unparalleled performance, customization, and a superior user experience by escaping the constraints of a shared blockchain. Hyperliquid, a decentralized perpetuals exchange, serves as a prime example. For saga-dex-project I want to a DEX with its own dedicated chain as a start of the hackathon.
how_its_made:
I use Saga to build my own Layer1. Since Saga is EVM compatible, I use hardhat to deploy solidity smart contracts of DEX and ERC20 tokens. I use ReactJS as the frontend framework. After I deploy my own EVM blockchain using Saga. I found out I can't deploy smart contract with the error message: "address format:ADDRESS_EIP55 value:"0x614e5492D0Be291E099b4E3595c51a88b2Ad6E11" not allowed to deploy contracts: unauthorized: unauthorized".
Therefore, for this hackathon, I list all the solidity smart contract in my repo. But didn't deploy them to my own chain.
